projects.title: Logdoctor
bullets: Built a command-line log analysis tool comparing OpenAI, Anthropic and Google LLM providers, using chalk and inquirer for interactive output.
Focused on making dense log output scannable in the terminal, after early versions were hard to read at a glance.

projects.title: Cloudinferops
bullets: Built a Kubernetes-native CLI in Go for deploying, monitoring and benchmarking LLM workloads, with CI, tests and Docker packaging.
Organized the 150-file codebase and its command structure so operators could find the right subcommand without reading source.

projects.title: Kubeops Platform
bullets: Wrote automation scripts deploying a full observability stack to a local Kubernetes cluster in a single run.

leadership.title: Documentation Contributor
bullets: New contributors to a shared campus tooling repo often gave up after the setup instructions assumed too much prior context.
Rewrote the onboarding guide with a clearer structure and screenshots of expected terminal output at each step.
Realized clear formatting changed whether people finished onboarding at all, more than the accuracy of the instructions did.
